perks.desc: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.desc: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Eye of the Storm
perks.desc: This weapon becomes more accurate and boosts handling as your health gets lower.

perks.name: Cascade Point

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: Target Lock
perks.desc: Damage increases the longer this weapon remains on a target.

perks.name: Hatchling
perks.desc: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn Enhanced
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. While this buff is active, grenade or melee final blows of the same damage type greatly increase its damage for an improved duration.

Being able to accurately hit your target is especially important on top of 600 autos having seen their day in the sun and need help."

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 55 (https://open.spotify.com/show/36OTFinErCUBrCzu6BaYbo) with @Saint_Kabr, @CourtProjects and @ImpetusAlways. First-choice PvE roll for add clear in end-game activities. Shapeable. This is the easier to get Strand adaptive auto-rifle for Season of Defiance, if you're unable to get into the Root of Nightmares Raid. The stats are decent, although both stability and handling are a little below par, and the recoil direction could maybe do with a little help, although the Noble Deeds origin perk can help out with the handling (and boost reload speed too). Extended Barrel or Smallbore are your best barrel choices, and Tactical Mag is the best of the mag perks. In the first trait column, there aren't many support perks that help in PvE - Keep Away is the pick of a limited budget, or possibly the reworked Zen Moment. For your second trait column signature perk, Golden Tricorn is unique (as at v7.0.0.6, anyway) on a Strand auto rifle and the second stack isn't too difficult to proc by either using a grapple melee or shooting a Tangle, for a massive 50% damage boost for 10s. Recommended MW: Range or Stability, with a damage-boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) or Backup Mag mod

Datto (PvE, MKB): "Obviously the main appeal here is Hatchling for any sort of Strand based builds, although I'd argue that Hatchling is more important on Warlock than Titan or Hunter. [...] Envious Assassin seems very appealing. Loads more ammo into the gun, but you gotta get some kills with other weapons and they gotta be rapid kills. If you're using a machine gun, it's a good perk on a different gun, like this one, but I don't think it's the instalock perk that some people may think it is. It's good though. Keep Away is another solid option, but I think it kinda depends on the content. You're using an auto-rifle, you do need to be SOMEWHAT close to things and that might prevent this perk from activating. Elemental Capacitor, ehh, not for strand in my opinion, for PvE anyway. I guess I'm probably going Envious still, the rest of the roster is eh. Second column, Hatchling if you're doing a Threadling build, but if you're not, it's not like it's the worst choice you can possibly make and I think a lot of people are gonna go for it anyway. Target Lock I'm not sold on unless you're doing higher level content where things aren't gonna die as quickly. I would say don't sleep on Golden Tricorn because Strand can proc Golden Tricorn x2 REALLY easily and that's a very significant damage boost that can have a lot of up time. Demolitionist is also not too bad of an idea, but if I'm getting Demo, then I'm gonna use the raid auto, which feels like a laser beam. Go for Arrowhead Brake, Accurized and Range masterwork."
